requireActivity.name: Require 'Avoid Notice' activity
requireActivity.hint: PCs are required to set the 'Avoid Notice' exploration activity active to hide at combat start. If disabled, PCs instead need to use stealth for initiative.
requireActivity.error: {actor} needs to use {action} if wanting to hide at combat start.

hideFromAllies.name: Party stealth affects party members
hideFromAllies.hint: If enabled, party member stealth effect can affect other party members. This checkbox doesn't apply to neutral or opposing tokens.

useEffects.name: Use PF2e Avoid Notice effects
useEffects.hint: If enabled, a Stealth effect will be applied to avoiding tokens which can track per-token visibility.

clearPartyStealthAfterCombat.name: Clear Stealth from Party after combat
clearPartyStealthAfterCombat.hint: Will remove stealth conditions from party tokens on the current scene when combat is ended.

panZoomToCombat.name: Pan/Zoom to combat
panZoomToCombat.hint: When combat starts, pan/zoom the camera to fit observed and hidden combatants for controlled tokens. Will ignore any foundry-hidden or undetected combatants.

showEyeballs.name: Enable eyeball indicators
showEyeballs.hint: Display eyeballs on canvas tokens that ignore the controlled tokens' stealth-based hidden and/or undetected conditions

collapseTargetList.name: Collapse Intiative Target Lists
collapseTargetList.hint: Initially collapse target lists when adding them to initiative chat cards

notifications.noSocketLib: PF2e Avoid Notice needs socketlib module to be active in order to pan/zoom to combat. Please activate it.
notifications.target1: Point Out action requires a single token to be targeted

schema.name: Schema Version
schema.hint: Set this to a previous version to force a data migration from the specified version to the current version

menu.name: PF2e Avoid Notice popup menu
menu.hint: Main interface for PF2e Avoid Notice

bindings.name: PF2e Avoid Notice Menu
bindings.hint: Open the PF2e Avoid Notice menu

menu.nothingToDo: PF2e Avoid Notice has no available actions for the given token(s)

refresh.label: Refresh All Clients
refresh.hint: Refresh all client screens to clear up any visibility issues

clearPartyStealth.label: Remove Party Stealth
clearPartyStealth.hint: Remove stealth effects from all party members

prepareAmbush.label: Prepare Ambush
prepareAmbush.hint: All {type} NPC tokens become ghosted and use stealth for initiative

clearAmbush.label: Clear Ambush
clearAmbush.hint: All {type} NPC tokens become unghosted and use perception for initiative

removeControlledStealth.label: Remove Controlled Stealth Effects
removeControlledStealth.hint: Remove Stealth Effects from controlled tokens

removeTargetedStealth.label: Remove Targeted Stealth Effects
removeTargetedStealth.hint: Remove Stealth Effects from targeted tokens

undoReveals.label: Undo Stealth Reveals
undoReveals.hint: Undo any stealth reveals of {type} tokens

avoidanceCheck.label: Check Avoidance
avoidanceCheck.hint: Run a stealth vs perception check for all stealthing {type} tokens

revealControlledToTargeted.label: Reveal controlled tokens to targeted
revealControlledToTargeted.hint: Reveal controlled tokens to targeted tokens

revealControlledAsHiddenToTargeted.label: Reveal controlled tokens as hidden to targeted
revealControlledAsHiddenToTargeted.hint: Reveal controlled tokens as hidden to targeted tokens

revealTargetedToControlled.label: Reveal targeted tokens to controlled
revealTargetedToControlled.hint: Reveal targeted tokens to controlled tokens

revealTargetedAsHiddenToControlled.label: Reveal targeted tokens as hidden to controlled
revealTargetedAsHiddenToControlled.hint: Reveal targeted tokens as hidden to controlled tokens

undoControlledRevealsToTargeted.label: Undo controlled tokens' reveals to targeted
undoControlledRevealsToTargeted.hint: Undo any reveals of controlled tokens' to targeted tokens

undoTargetedRevealsToControlled.label: Undo reveals of targeted tokens' condition
undoTargetedRevealsToControlled.hint: Undo any reveals of targeted tokens' to controlled tokens

declump.label: Declump Initiative
declump.hint: Preserve initiative order but spread out all initiatives

menu.endOfList: end of list so I don't have to mess with commas

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.description: Stealth effect will apply hidden/undetected to observer tokens as appropriate
